pages.text: This addon backports parts of local $(thing)1.21 TerraFirmaCraft$() worldgen, climate semantics, shorelines, ocean depth, and plant growth parameters to $(thing)1.20.1$().$(br2)This entry only documents content that is actually wired into the current project, so you can quickly judge local climate, crop suitability, and what terrain families may appear nearby.

pages.title: Climate and Seasons
pages.text: The addon still uses TFC's $(thing)Calendar$() and $(thing)Climate$() screens. Press $(item)$(k:key.inventory)$() to open the inventory, then check the calendar tab for the season and date. A year is divided into Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter, with Early / Mid / Late months for each.$(br2)This project aligns the 1.21 temperature, rainfall, and seasonal semantics back onto 1.20, and those values now directly affect weather, crops, and part of the plant growth logic.

$(l:the_world/climate#temperature)Temperature$() is driven mainly by latitude Z, season, and day to day variation. $(l:mechanics/hydration)Rainfall / Hydration$() is driven mainly by longitude X, distance from the coast, and seasonal rainfall patterns. In general, areas farther east are wetter, inland regions are drier, east coasts trend toward wet summers, and west coasts trend toward dry summers.$(br2)The current project already wires 1.21 style average temperature, current temperature, average rainfall, current rainfall, and peak rainfall into the client screens and weather backend.

pages.title: Terrain Families
pages.text: Worldgen currently focuses on five major families: $(thing)coasts and oceans$(), $(thing)arid landforms$(), $(thing)karst$(), $(thing)volcanic landforms$(), and $(thing)glacial / ice sheet terrain$().$(br2)These are not placed as isolated decorations. Final biome choice depends on temperature, rainfall, hotspot age, distance to the coast, and whether exposed rock is treated as karst.

pages.title: Crop Rules
pages.text: Crops in this addon still use the main $(thing)1.20 TFC$() farming mechanics. The temperature and $(l:mechanics/hydration)hydration$() values listed here are the current growth parameters used by this pack, for choosing crops by region.$(br2)The addon crops have detailed pages in $(l:new_terra_earth/ported_crops)Ported Crops$(). The full farming guide still lives in $(l:mechanics/crops)Crops$().

$(bold)Cereals$()$(br)$(li)Barley: -7~23 C / 10~70%$(li)Oat: -7~22 C / 25~85%$(li)Rye: -7~18 C / 15~80%$(li)Maize: -7~27 C / 50~100%$(li)Wheat: -7~22 C / 15~85%$(li)Rice: 8~31 C / 35~100%, must grow in shallow fresh water
$(bold)Legumes$()$(br)$(li)Cassava: 10~31 C / 45~100%$(li)Green Beans: -2~25 C / 25~90%, climbs with a stick$(li)Lentils: -5~25 C / 15~50%$(li)Peanuts: 11~31 C / 20~80%$(li)Soybean: -7~22 C / 25~90%
